items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And Shields was with us then on.

ctx.x: Who was the clarinet between Shields and Nunes, if any? Was there anybody in between? Nobody?

Shields joined at, Shields had been around Chicago and he hadn't been doing anything. And we saw him. And I asked him, how would you like to come with us? Geez, I wish I could. I said, well, I think we'll be able to make it because Nunes, every once in a while, he quits. Comes in late. Quits. He thinks he can't get anyone else. And he believes that he has the upper hand. So, the next time he quits, which will be in a few days, because he does it almost nightly. He will call you up and you come right down. So, he…
and after you got to New York you had the same band as we stated now yeah the Rising Webbers were there any changes there ever in Rising Webbers?
